quotes.use: error from the unknown wall shape is not compensated (journal p. 1010)
quotes.text: Using a simulated model can introduce a simulation error, coming from a difference between the actual waveguide geometry (both dimensions, shape, and material properties) and the trapezoidal geometry model we used in the mode solver. This means that some parameters will be only relative.
